Genius Game

Source: R/genius.R
genius_game.Rd

One row per finished game: period and clock state, both teams' names, codes and scores, officials.

Endpoint: GET https://fibalivestats.dcd.shared.geniussports.com/data/{match_id}/data.json

team1 is the team listed first. referee1 ... commissioner read officials.<role> (current feeds) or the flat officials_refereeN strings (older feeds); NA when absent.

Usage

genius_game(match_id, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

match_id

Genius match id (match_id of genius_schedule(), genius_widget_games() or genius_competition_games()), e.g. 2902690.

return_parsed

Parse into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the parsed body or page record (a list): data.json as served plus _request (the ids asked for), or the sdv-internal-refs capture shape of a page.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble (a zero-row tibble with these columns when Genius answers an empty valid page), or the raw list when return_parsed = FALSE:

col_nametypedescription
match_idintegerGenius match id of the game. data.json does not carry it: it is the match_id asked for, stamped by the runtime (the global match sequence shared by every Genius customer).
periodintegerCurrent (or last) period number; restarts at 1 in overtime
period_typecharacterCurrent period type: REGULAR or OVERTIME
in_otinteger1 when the game is (or ended) in overtime, else 0
clockcharacterClock of the current period at capture time, 'mm:ss' remaining ('00:00' once the game is over)
periods_maxintegerNumber of regulation periods (4)
period_length_regularintegerLength of a regulation period, minutes (10 under FIBA rules, 12 in some leagues)
period_length_overtimeintegerLength of an overtime period, minutes
attendanceintegerAttendance as entered by the org; 0 when not entered
disable_matchinteger1 when the org disabled the public feed for this game, else 0
total_time_addedintegerClock time added by corrections, seconds (unverified; 0 in every sample)
team1_namecharacterFull name of team 1, the team listed first (the home team on the hosted schedule and widget).
team1_codecharacterShort code of team 1, in the competition's own script when the org enters one.
team1_scoreintegerFinal points of team 1 (cast to an integer; the 2014-15 feed sends a string).
team2_namecharacterFull name of team 2, the team listed second.
team2_codecharacterShort code of team 2, in the competition's own script when the org enters one.
team2_scoreintegerFinal points of team 2 (cast to an integer; the 2014-15 feed sends a string).
referee1characterFirst referee's name, from officials.referee1 (international form) or the flat officials_referee1 text.
referee2characterSecond referee's name, from officials.referee2 (international form) or the flat officials_referee2 text.
referee3characterThird referee's name when the feed lists one; null otherwise.
commissionercharacterCommissioner (game supervisor) name when the feed lists one; null otherwise.

Details

Access. The Genius hosts publish no robots.txt and no terms. CloudFront refuses datacenter IPs on the LiveStats and hosted hosts: from a server set options(hoopR.proxy = ...) or the GENIUS_PROXY environment variable to an http(s) proxy URL (never printed or logged). Requests are spaced at least one second apart per host; keep crawls slow and incremental. Some league sites (the NZ NBL) forbid AI crawlers in their own robots.txt, which does not cover these hosts. Unofficial use of a public source: payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

Org and season. Every competition is an ORG code plus a competition id (comp_id): genius_competitions() lists an org's competitions with the sdv END-year season (a START-year org lists 2025-26 as season 2026), genius_match_competition() maps a game to its competition, and data.json itself names no date, competition or season. The hosted ORG can differ from the LiveStats ORG of /u/ (NZNBL vs NZN). Match ids are one global sequence across every Genius customer. data.json carries no global team or player id: tno (1 or 2) and pno are in-game numbers; only finished games are read.

Errors (classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error): hoopR_no_data when Genius has nothing for the request (HTTP 404, the S3 AccessDenied 403, an empty 200 from the hosted host, an empty recent-games window, a schedule or widget with no matches); hoopR_bad_request for HTTP 400 / 422 or a URL that is not a Genius route (e.g. a non-numeric id); hoopR_asset_fetch when the answer is unknown: the CloudFront "Request blocked" 403, a rate limit or 5xx, the intermittent HTTP 500 "A website error has occurred" page (transient = TRUE: retry later), a dead connection, an error envelope, a cut-off page, an unfinished game, or a body for another match, competition or ORG.

See also

Other Genius: bal_competition, esake_competition, genius_competition_games(), genius_competitions(), genius_game_crosswalk(), genius_match_competition(), genius_pbp(), genius_player_box(), genius_schedule(), genius_schedule_embed(), genius_shots(), genius_team_box(), genius_team_crosswalk(), genius_widget_games(), lnbm_competition, lub_competition, nznbl_competition, slb_competition

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(genius_game(match_id = 2902690))
#> ── Genius LiveStats game ──────────────────────────────────────── hoopR 3.2.0 ──
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-10-18 19:27:58 UTC
#> # A tibble: 1 × 21
#>   match_id period period_type in_ot clock periods_max period_length_regular
#>      <int>  <int> <chr>       <int> <chr>       <int>                 <int>
#> 1  2902690      1 OVERTIME        1 00:00           4                    10
#> # ℹ 14 more variables: period_length_overtime <int>, attendance <int>,
#> #   disable_match <int>, total_time_added <int>, team1_name <chr>,
#> #   team1_code <chr>, team1_score <int>, team2_name <chr>, team2_code <chr>,
#> #   team2_score <int>, referee1 <chr>, referee2 <chr>, referee3 <chr>,
#> #   commissioner <chr>
# }
